task: Sister requested external-vs-S10 reaction / Gold-pair / positive-UID overlap; no generation or training
positive_label: Label == 1; negative rows never establish seen-positive pairs or positive UID membership
canonical_primary: RDKit sanitized molecular graphs, clear atom mapping, canonical isomeric SMILES per connected component, sort components on each side, keep reaction direction; preserve specified stereochemistry, isotope, formal charge, components and multiplicity. No tautomer/protonation/cofactor balancing or implicit reaction equivalence.
stereo_secondary: Same graph normalization after RemoveStereochemistry; all such results separate, never silently substituted for primary
parse_failures: Preserve per-record error and UNKNOWN; no failed canonicalization treated as a confirmed non-overlap
reaction_metric: Step target directed canonical reaction appears in split positive reaction set; count steps, not distinct reactions
gold_primary: Step target directed canonical reaction + exact Gold scientific UID appears as a positive sample in that split. A step is overlapped if ANY retained Gold matches. Also report ALL-Gold matched and pair counts.
gold_sequence_sensitivity: Same reaction + exact sequence SHA; count independently because training-carrier UID aliases can hide identical proteins. No homology threshold or full homology audit.
uid_membership: Unique candidate UIDs in each external view intersect split positive UIDs; additionally report step-candidate association weighting separately
family_secondary: Reuse actual frozen S7 INTERNAL_SPLIT_GROUP construction, including exact reverse representation; verify implementation / stored group IDs before counting. This is an operational exact forward/reverse family, not EC/mechanism/homology grouping.

frozen_masks.PRIMARY_DROP_TRAIN_GOLD_UID_PAIR: drop every step with primary canonical reaction x Gold UID match in TRAIN positive rows, same steps for all six arms
frozen_masks.SENSITIVITY_DROP_TRAIN_GOLD_SEQUENCE_PAI: drop every step with canonical reaction x exact Gold sequence SHA match in TRAIN positive rows
frozen_masks.SENSITIVITY_DROP_TRAIN_REACTION: drop train-positive directed canonical reaction overlap
frozen_masks.SENSITIVITY_DROP_TRAIN_FAMILY: drop train-positive original S7 forward/reverse group overlap
frozen_masks.SENSITIVITY_DROP_ANY_SPLIT_GOLD_UID_PAIR: drop primary Gold UID pair if present in train OR valid OR test, exposure sensitivity only

mask_freeze_order: This file is sealed before calculating overlap counts or any filtered metrics. First produce matching tables and step masks without reading ranks; seal mask SHA, then read existing per-step metrics.
metrics: Reuse unchanged six-arm per-step results. No rerank, candidate deletion, Gold deletion, forwards or new model selection. Report original and filtered n, Hit@1/3/5/10, MRR and MRR@10 with differences in percentage points for hits.

sister_thresholds.lt_5_percent: keep full-view primary; filtered supplement; measure actual change before saying unchanged
sister_thresholds.5_through_20_percent_inclusive: keep full-view primary; filtered supplement and knowledge-interpolation wording
sister_thresholds.gt_20_percent: recommend filtered primary and full-view supplement; remove unseen/generalization claims

threshold_basis: Primary TRAIN directed canonical reaction x exact Gold UID step fraction, separately 382/338. Sequence-alias sensitivity and partial-family caveats must accompany decision. No subgroup outcome changes masks.
interpretation_limits: S10 overlap audit does not certify old-formal training sets of the three original-formal arms as unseen
No family/UID match alone proves a positive reaction-enzyme pair was seen
If only some steps remain in a path, filtered set is steps from 82 paths, not 82 complete pathways
No hypothesis of unchanged conclusions is preaccepted
